title: Lint rules: no waits or retries in tests, skips need quarantine task, suppressions need human
body: From t-tq04sec trick 4. Source: pingdotgg/t3code oxlint-plugin-t3code/rules (no-real-time-wait-in-tests, no-polling-loop-in-tests, no-test-timeout-or-unreasoned-skip). KRN: small check in scripts/ run by npm run lint: no sleep/setTimeout waits or retry in test/, skip needs '// quarantine: t-xxxx'. Plus deliver gate: diff adding biome-ignore/@ts-ignore/skip needs a human (trick 5). S-M.
